items.title: Cloudflare and VoidZero Introduce tsrs: An AI-Generated Rust Port of TypeScript
items.blurb: Cloudflare, VoidZero and Max Schwenk announced tsrs, an experimental Rust port of the TypeScript compiler, built with the TypeScript team's involvement.
